title: Zonin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Avodah Zarah 55a, Zonin tells Rabbi Akiva, “You and I both know that idolatry has no substance, yet we see people who go there broken and return healed.” Rashi explains that Zonin was Jewish, but Hyman thinks the wording suggests he was a gentile, an inference also argued by Maharsha in Chiddushei Aggadot.

notes.text: מאו״הע means “from the nations of the world,” a gentile, not one of the Ten Tribes. Hyman expressly contrasts this interpretation with Rashi’s Jewish identification.
